name: dominicanewsonline.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and model-training crawlers are blocked by choice. But links must have discernible text.
lesson: Give every link text that says where it goes. An icon alone needs an aria-label.
summary: dominicanewsonline.com scores 64 out of 100 (D). 7 checks fail now, 27 are at risk, and 28 pass. Fix first: 25 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 25 form controls have no label
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 1 AI answer or search crawler is blocked
fix.evidence: Amazonbot (Alexa answers) by Disallow: /. These bots fetch pages to cite them in answers. Blocked means the site is not quoted there.
fix.fix: Allow the answer bots in robots.txt. Training bots can stay blocked if that is the policy.

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 5 elements on /news/, for example li:nth-child(1) > a[target="_self"]:nth-child(1) and li:nth-child(2) > a[target="_self"]:nth-child(1). Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Analytics (3 requests), Google Ads (2 requests), and cookies _ga, _ga_MWJR60HYW5, __cf_bm on twitter.com.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: 18 pages have no meta description
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 3 elements on /news/, for example #post-370128 > .no-gutters.row > .col-lg-9.post-content > .entry-header > .entry-title > a[rel="bookmark"] and #post-370128 > .no-gutters.row > .col-lg-9.post-content > .entry-header > .entry-meta.…
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.
